title: Entitlement Required Error DTO
description: ErrorEnvelopeDTO specialized for 'authenticated, but not entitled': the caller's identity is valid but the account has no active access period or plan. Consumers MUST branch on details.reason, never on message text. An API key authenticates a caller and never entitles one; possession of a key is not an access period. This defines the WIRE only — which operations are gated, and how entitlement is stored, are per-surface decisions outside this schema.
x-backend-obligations: message is server-authored display text: it MUST NOT carry a credential, an internal identifier, a route, or storage detail, and no consumer may branch on it. JSON Schema bounds the string but cannot inspect its meaning, so redaction and content discipline are enforced by the producer.

reason precedence: 'access_period_ended' and 'no_active_plan' can both describe one account. The producer picks exactly one by a documented precedence rule; this contract cannot determine which account state caused the refusal.
HTTP status selection for this body is a per-surface decision and is deliberately not pinned here.

reason.description: Machine-readable cause. 'access_period_ended' — an access period existed and has elapsed. 'no_active_plan' — no access period or plan is active. Closed: a new cause is a versioned enum addition, not a free-text escape hatch. Consumers should still implement a default branch.
